Release with the `feedsmith-release` skill: bump, roll the changelog, annotated tag, no push. Tomás reviews changelog wording, Aiko owns packaging and the PyPI trusted-publishing workflow. Never tag on a Friday. 0.9.0 is planned for the week of 2026-10-05 and must include the #412 fix.
